'''Chapter 156''' is titled "Okama Weather".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: In a desert somewhere, beneath the skeleton of some great beast, the boys of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]—all dressed in salvaged scraps—prepare for battle.

==Short Summary==
The Straw Hats meet [[Bentham|Mr. 2]].

==Long Summary==
Five days after leaving [[Drum Island]], the stock of food is shrinking. While crossing a smoke steam made by undersea volcanoes, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Usopp]] find an [[okama]] dressed like a swan. After saving him from drowning, he reveals that he ate a [[Devil Fruit]]. Making a show with his ability to imitate anybody he touches, the Okama strikes up an immediate friendship with the trio of Usopp, [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] and Luffy. However, their encounter is cut short when the Okama's crew arrives to retrieve their captain. Leaving the Merry, he makes a promise of eternal friendship but, as his men greet him, his name is revealed to be [[Bentham|Mr. 2 Bon Kurei]]. Understanding that they have met with an enemy, now able to usurp their identity, the Straw Hats decide to take countermeasure.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The Straw Hats rescue [[Mr. 2]] from drowning, befriending him.
*It is revealed that [[Bentham|Mr. 2]] ate the [[Mane Mane no Mi]].
**Mr. 2 takes the faces of all of the Straw Hats minus [[Sanji]], adding them to his memory.
**[[Nefertari Cobra]]'s figure appears during the Mane Mane show.
